snippet.title: Baptiste | World Premiere The Horror Game Awards 2026
snippet.description:
Baptiste, a psychological horror game about a cursed doll and a haunted mansion, launches March 25, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2 and PC (Steam). After a family tragedy, young Tom moves with his mother Sara into Jagged Shore Cliff, an isolated mansion hiding dark secrets. Inside a glass cabinet he finds Baptiste, a creepy doll with one warning attached: never let it out. He didn’t listen. Explore the haunted house through the eyes of a frightened child, uncover its past through notes and clues, solve puzzles and survive as doors stop behaving, floors begin to whisper and reality slowly falls apart, until you can no longer tell whether the terror is real or born from a grieving mind. Made by indie studio Firenut Games, Baptiste is an atmospheric horror adventure about grief, family and madness for fans of slow burn psychological horror. Wishlist now and play the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922250/Baptiste/ | PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP6974-PPSA34892_00-0205334311447322 | Xbox Store: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/baptiste/9p5v6jd1g30q | Follow Firenut Games on X: https://x.com/firenutgames | Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/firenutgames.bsky.social | Discord: https://discord.gg/qsCzxnFCuF---
Originally aired during The Horror Game Awards 2026 on Friday 20 November 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
